steps.instruction: Press HARNESS to lock your seat harness.
steps.hint: HARNESS is on the SEAT panel to your left. Locking it holds you in your seat through the launch forces.
ENGINE ARM is the first switch on the FLIGHT panel ahead. Arming lets the flight computer start the engines.
Turn the GUIDANCE dial on the FLIGHT panel to INTERNAL. The ship then steers itself instead of following ground commands.

steps.instruction: Press LAUNCH to start the final countdown.
steps.hint: LAUNCH is the third control on the FLIGHT panel. The countdown runs ten seconds and the engines ignite at T-6.
Turn the THROTTLE dial on the right of the FLIGHT panel to 70%. Less thrust protects the ship through peak air pressure.

steps.instruction: Press STAGE when BOOSTER SEP lights up.
steps.hint: STAGE is on the lower row of the FLIGHT panel. Wait for the amber BOOSTER SEP light: the empty booster must drop away.

steps.instruction: Grab the FIRE EXT from its bracket.
steps.hint: The FIRE EXT hangs on its bracket by your left knee. Grab it first; you cannot fight a fire bare-handed.

steps.instruction: Spray the FIRE on the AUX POWER panel.
steps.hint: Holding the extinguisher, tap the FIRE on the AUX POWER panel below the FLIGHT panel. The CO2 smothers the flames.

steps.instruction: Press TOWER JETT to drop the escape tower.
steps.hint: TOWER JETT is in the middle of the lower row. Above the thick air, the escape tower is only extra weight.

steps.instruction: Press CUTOFF when ORBIT lights up.
steps.hint: CUTOFF is on the right of the lower row. Wait for the green ORBIT light; cutting off early leaves you short of orbit.

steps.instruction: Press REPORT to confirm you are in orbit.
steps.hint: REPORT is on the COMMS panel to your right. Mission control needs your call to confirm a safe orbit.
